| # bds_out_aov_cfg {#bds_out_aov_cfg-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Configures the voltage deviation for an analog voltage output.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Maximal allowed deviation between the set point and the actual voltage is 500mV. The signal quality of the PWM must be considered for the deviation value.    

- For more information see [bds_out_aov_getStatus](bds_out_aov_getstatus.html){.topiclink}.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  This API can be used in trusted partitions. For untrusted partitions use bds_out_aov_cfg_ffi. See [Freedom from Interference (FFI) concept](freedom-from-interference.html){.topiclink} for more details.
